title: Figure 2: Modified 747 Dreamlifter unloading a Boeing 787 composite fuselage barrel
description: Color photograph of a Boeing 747 'Dreamlifter' cargo aircraft with its swing tail open on an airport apron while a large cylindrical fuselage section is unloaded, with ground crew and vehicles around it. Caption: "Figure 2. Specially Modified 747 Transporter Unloading a Boeing 787 Composite Fuselage Barrel Section." It illustrates text on automated tow placement in polymer-matrix composite manufacturing.
